A bill debate URI that maps to a whole sitting/debate cannot by itself label every speech in that debate as legislation.
Exact same-debate heading matches are diagnostics until source semantics and false positives are manually reviewed.
Heading term matches are diagnostics only; ambiguous cases remain other.
